observations: Crosswalk matrix aligns counts and retains original relationship direction and authority in the detail list. Phone evidence details distinguish accepted review, validity, and direct/group links.
Plan urgency rows use aligned readable text and persistent status counts. Browser geometry verifies six Board columns and due-only Timeline markers.
CSF profile category rows align current, target and gap with numeric columns. Separate tier tab retains drafts through refresh/save failures; phone comparisons remain locally scrollable.
Agent stages show completed, rejected and unrecorded outcomes with text labels; decision views precede technical flight details.
History shows recorded points and exact values with comparison breaks. Final phone chart labels remain readable at a minimum chart width, inside a named scroll region with a visible focus outline.
All five added stylesheets use defined tokens. Added row feedback inherits the global reduced-motion override.
limits: Expert visual inspection, not a user study or a comprehensive accessibility certification.
